goal: Separate cellular service registration, APN/DNN configuration, EPS PDN / 5GS PDU session state, IP/link properties, DNS, validation and actual user-data success.
official_basis: 3GPP EPS/5GS architecture references distinguishing registration and packet sessions
Android ServiceState and data registration APIs
Apple APN and MDM cellular payload guidance
key_rules: Service/signal indication does not prove data registration.
Registration does not prove APN/DNN session.
APN profile presence does not prove selection or connection.
Connected session does not prove DNS or validated Internet.
INTERNET capability does not equal VALIDATED.
Runtime mobile-data success does not backfill APN/DNN/IP/DNS internals.
APN and eSIM profile configuration remain separate.
5G SA registration does not prove VoNR.
next_phase: Phase159 Firmware / Baseband / Carrier Bundle versioned snapshot model.
